problem_text:
A logistics company is tasked with allocating its fleet of nine specialized cargo aircraft to transport nine distinct categories of high-value commodities across a network. The revenue generated per metric ton for each commodity class is detailed as follows:
* For Commodity Alpha, revenue is 5.761 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Beta, revenue is 18.707 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Gamma, revenue is 9.377 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Delta, revenue is 7.955 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Epsilon, revenue is 14.826 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Zeta, revenue is 8.636 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Eta, revenue is 13.479 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Theta, revenue is 16.459 per metric ton.
* For Commodity Iota, revenue is 15.015 per metric ton.

The loading and handling time required per metric ton for each aircraft type is specified:
* For Commodity Alpha, Aircraft 1 requires 0.771 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.34 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 1.332 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 0.237 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.03 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 1.339 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 0.887 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 0.489 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.843 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Beta, Aircraft 1 requires 0.22 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.757 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 0.5 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 1.984 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.839 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 0.365 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.582 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.402 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.756 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Gamma, Aircraft 1 requires 1.094 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 0.762 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 1.623 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 1.526 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.165 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 1.974 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.585 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.095 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.866 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Delta, Aircraft 1 requires 1.11 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.718 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 0.29 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 0.434 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 0.583 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 0.618 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 0.453 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 0.275 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.207 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Epsilon, Aircraft 1 requires 1.262 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.508 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 1.307 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 1.016 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.01 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 0.225 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.31 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.345 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.326 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Zeta, Aircraft 1 requires 1.931 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.466 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 0.579 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 1.299 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.197 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 1.411 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.271 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.563 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.024 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Eta, Aircraft 1 requires 1.22 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.866 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 0.675 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 1.392 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.528 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 1.678 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.232 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.954 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.933 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Theta, Aircraft 1 requires 1.125 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.014 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 0.386 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 1.257 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 0.76 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 1.438 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.489 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.759 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.538 (ton-hours).
* For Commodity Iota, Aircraft 1 requires 1.657 (ton-hours), Aircraft 2 requires 1.714 (ton-hours), Aircraft 3 requires 1.993 (ton-hours), Aircraft 4 requires 0.792 (ton-hours), Aircraft 5 requires 1.26 (ton-hours), Aircraft 6 requires 1.203 (ton-hours), Aircraft 7 requires 1.228 (ton-hours), Aircraft 8 requires 1.402 (ton-hours), Aircraft 9 requires 1.886 (ton-hours).

The cumulative operational time window for each aircraft is strictly limited:
* Aircraft 1's total available time is capped at 69.512 hours.
* Aircraft 2's total available time is capped at 118.182 hours.
* Aircraft 3's total available time is capped at 60.704 hours.
* Aircraft 4's total available time is capped at 69.083 hours.
* Aircraft 5's total available time is capped at 74.14 hours.
* Aircraft 6's total available time is capped at 69.225 hours.
* Aircraft 7's total available time is capped at 85.439 hours.
* Aircraft 8's total available time is capped at 84.601 hours.
* Aircraft 9's total available time is capped at 111.676 hours.

Under the imperative condition that for each individual aircraft—Aircraft 1 through Aircraft 9—the aggregate processing duration must remain within its respective temporal capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each commodity category to maximize the aggregate revenue for the logistics operation.
